subject: Proposed MAP + Marketplace private-offer staircase for Vertex Retail
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@vertexretail.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Evaluation scope + marketplace pricing questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Vertex has interest in a short evaluation to validate inference latency and cost at our 8k token median use case. Procurement asked me to reach out with two asks so we can move toward an internal approval:

1) Can you provide a mutual action plan (MAP) that maps objective milestones -> timing -> acceptance criteria? We want milestones we can attach to a staged commitment.
2) For customers who want to buy through AWS Marketplace private offers, can you outline how pricing ramps and discounts will be tied to MAP milestones (we need to show finance how discounts are triggered)?

If you can send an initial MAP and a sample private-offer term sheet, that will help us scope our internal evaluation (security + procurement).

Thanks,
CJ Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Vertex Retail
procurement@vertexretail.com

Attachment: none

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: CJ Park <procurement@vertexretail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-01T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation scope + marketplace pricing questions

Hi CJ — great to hear Vertex is ready to move forward. I pulled together a concise MAP and an example AWS Private Offer term sheet to show how discounts ladder against milestone commits. Drafts attached.

High level (summary):
- M1 (4-week POC): validate latency and integration. Acceptance: <100ms median for 8k tokens on the POC workload + sample prompt set. No commit required.
- M2 (pilot, 3 months): production pilot with capped reserved capacity. Acceptance: sustained 95th percentile latency SLA and accuracy checks on the eval set. On signing of M2 commit, Vertex receives 10% off list for Marketplace private offer.
- M3 (12-month commit): full production rollout. Commit unlocks additional stepped discounts (20% at $X committed spend; 30% at $Y). Detailed breakpoints are in the term sheet.

I've CC'd Ben (solutions) and Lauren (AE) to align on technical acceptance criteria and term sequencing. Next step: Ben will propose exact POC tests and timelines; Lauren will prep a draft private-offer term sheet to enable fast approval once Vertex confirms the MAP.

Attached: Vertex_MAP_v3.pdf, AWS_PrivateOffer_TermSheet.xlsx

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

Attachments: Vertex_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP draft), AWS_PrivateOffer_TermSheet.xlsx (example pricing staircase)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-02T11:17:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: POC acceptance criteria + pricing ladder notes

Tessa / Lauren — quick internal note while I draft the POC plan for CJ. Key items for the MAP we should make explicit:

- POC scope (M1): 3 targeted stores, 10k inference calls/day with 8k token median. Tests: cold-start latency, KV-cache hit scenarios, tail-latency at 99th percentile. Deliverable: POC report with token-level cost and latency breakdown.

- Pilot (M2): 90-day pilot w/ reserved slots. Ask: Vertex to commit to a 3-month reserved capacity (monthly min $75k) to get initial Marketplace private-offer discount (10%).

- Ramp/Commit (M3): 12-month commit with staged discount breakpoints:
  * $900k annual commit -> 20% off list
  * $1.75M annual commit -> 30% off list
  * Additional performance SLAs (99.9 uptime) included at the $1.75M tier.

- Technical acceptance: we should insist on representative traffic (not synthetic) for the POC to be valid for M2 unlock. Include an "acceptance signoff" form (POC-acceptance-criteria.docx).

I attached the acceptance doc and a redline of the term sheet with example language for Marketplace private offer gating (explicitly tie discount unlocks to signed MAP milestone acceptance and HubSpot deal milestone).

Ben
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: POC-acceptance-criteria.docx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: CJ Park <procurement@vertexretail.com>, Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@vertexretail.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-15T10:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation scope + marketplace pricing questions — MAP & Private Offer (draft)

Hi CJ / Amelia — attaching an updated MAP and a sample AWS Private Offer term sheet that maps discounts to milestone signoffs. Summary below so your finance team can see the mechanics quickly.

MAP (high level):
- M1: 4-week POC (no financial commit). Acceptance: POC report + signoff by Vertex ML lead. Timeline: target kickoff Jan 4 — complete by Feb 1.
- M2: 90-day pilot. Vertex commits to minimum monthly spend of $75k for 3 months (total $225k). On signed M2 commit and acceptance, Redwood will request AWS to configure a private offer that applies a 10% list discount to the account for the pilot period.
- M3: 12-month committed purchase. On signed M3, private offer will be updated with the agreed annual commit discount tier. Breakpoints in term sheet: 20% at $900k, 30% at $1.75M annual committed spend.

How Marketplace private offers work (short): Redwood submits a private-offer request to AWS with the negotiated unit pricing and discount table. AWS links the private offer to Vertex's marketplace account; once Vertex accepts the private offer via the marketplace, the discounted pricing applies. For MAP-linked unlocks we will:
  1) Attach a DocuSign MAP acceptance to the deal (HubSpot ID included).
  2) Once we have the signed MAP milestone (M2 or M3), Redwood will request AWS to enable the corresponding pricing tier on the private offer.

Next steps we propose:
- Vertex to review attached MAP and mark any changes to acceptance criteria.
- If acceptable, sign M1 MAP (no cost) to start POC on Jan 4.
- Redwood to prepare the AWS private-offer term sheet (attached) and open a draft private-offer in AWS to reserve the negotiated rate for Vertex while POC runs.

Attachments: Vertex_MAP_v3.pdf, AWS_PrivateOffer_TermSheet.xlsx

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-874230-VP-2026-427 
AWS private-offer preview: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp-private-offer/12345-vertex-retail
DocuSign MAP: https://docusign.com/secure/EnvelopeABC123

Happy to hop on a quick call this week if your legal/procurement want to walk through the gating language.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0133

Attachments: Vertex_MAP_v3.pdf, AWS_PrivateOffer_TermSheet.xlsx

From: CJ Park <procurement@vertexretail.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-01-12T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation scope + marketplace pricing questions — MAP & Private Offer (draft)

Tessa — thanks for the clear MAP and the term sheet. Vertex is prepared to sign the M1 MAP to start the POC on Jan 4. A few quick notes from procurement/legal before we sign M2:

1) We need SOC 2 artifacts and an audit log sample before we commit to the M2 reserved spend. Can Redwood provide a SOC 2 report and a 30-day sample of audit logs (redacted) attached to the HubSpot deal?
2) We prefer the 90-day pilot (M2) to be time-boxed to Feb 15 — May 15, so our seasonal peak planning isn't impacted. Can you confirm those dates?
3) We will sign M2 once the SOC 2 artifacts are delivered and the POC acceptance form is completed. After signature, we'll accept the AWS private offer from the HubSpot/AWS link so the 10% discount applies immediately for the pilot.

If you can get SOC2 + audit logs into the HubSpot file repo and give a confirm on the M2 pilot dates, I'll route for internal signoff.

I'll countersign the DocuSign envelope for M1 today so Ben's team can start the POC.

Best,
CJ Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Vertex Retail
procurement@vertexretail.com
